cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises its arm to a 'waving' position, with the gripper facing forward, then performs a rhythmic side-to-side wrist oscillation to signal greeting.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: The robot's arm rises from a neutral position to an elevated gesture of greeting or acknowledgement, holding the position momentarily.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot moves its arm downwards and slightly forward from a neutral position, holding a lowered pose to convey respect or as a greeting bow.

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward and slightly upward, positioning its gripper vertically to indicate an invitation for a handshake. The motion is deliberate and ends with a hold.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward, aligns its gripper vertically, and performs a series of quick up-and-down movements to imitate shaking a hand.

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot brings its arm across its chest to the opposite side, mimicking a self-embrace gesture to convey comfort or hugging.

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: The robot brings its fingertips close to its lips, then performs a small, quick outward motion, simulating blowing a kiss.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot arm extends above its head and uses a series of coordinated arcs to trace a heart shape in the air, expressing love or affection.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot raises its arm and places its gripper (representing a hand) flat against its chest, holding it there to convey sincerity or gratitude.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The robot arm rapidly raises its 'fist' high and slightly forward, holding the peak position to signify victory or excitement, mimicking a human's two-fist victory pose with one arm.

cue: Pump one fist downward (Success / Yes!)
description: The robot positions its arm with a forward-facing 'fist' at chest height, then executes a swift and emphatic downward thrust, followed by a minor upward rebound, signifying success or agreement.

cue: Flex one arm to show bicep (Strength)
description: The robot extends its arm slightly forward, then sharply bends its elbow to bring the gripper close to its shoulder, mimicking a bicep flex to signal strength, and holds the pose.

cue: Nod head up and down (Yes)
description: The robot performs a repetitive up-and-down motion of its gripper, mimicking a 'yes' head nod.

cue: Shake head side to side (No)
description: The robot's arm moves its gripper laterally in a repetitive side-to-side motion, as if shaking its head to indicate 'no'.

cue: Shrug shoulders with palms up (I don’t know)
description: The robot arm moves from a relaxed position to a raised, slightly extended posture with the gripper opening facing upwards, mimicking a human 'I don't know' shrug.

cue: Scratch head lightly (Confusion)
description: The robot arm moves to its head, specifically the temple area, and performs small, light scratching motions to convey confusion or contemplation.

cue: Tilt head slightly (Curiosity)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral position to the upper body, mimicking a head position, then performs a subtle lateral shift to convey a gesture of curiosity or questioning.

cue: Place palm over face (Facepalm / Frustration)
description: The robot moves its arm from a neutral position to place the palm of its gripper over its face, holding the pose to convey frustration or exasperation.

cue: Point to chest with index finger (Me)
description: The robot arm moves to point its gripper tip at its own chest, symbolizing 'me' or self-reference, then holds the pose.

cue: Point forward with index finger (You)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the gripper pointing ahead, signifying 'you' or indicating a direction.

cue: Turn palm downward and curl fingers inward repeatedly (Come here / Beckon)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the gripper facing down, then performs a rapid, repetitive inward curling motion of the gripper, simulating a beckoning gesture.

cue: Extend palm forward flat (Stop)
description: The robot extends its arm forward from a neutral position, with the gripper opening held vertically, mimicking a human 'stop' gesture with an open palm. The position is held briefly.

cue: Raise index finger upright (One moment / Important point)
description: The robot's arm moves from a neutral position, lifting and extending forward. The wrist then rotates the gripper so it points directly upwards, signaling 'one moment' or emphasizing a key point.

cue: Place index finger on lips (Shh / Be quiet)
description: The robot raises its arm and places its index finger on its lips, holding it there to signal 'shh' or 'be quiet'.

cue: Pat stomach lightly (Hungry / Full)
description: The robot positions its gripper horizontally at stomach level, then performs a series of rapid, light taps using its elbow to indicate hunger or fullness.

cue: Rub both upper arms (Cold)
description: The robot arm reaches across its body to simulate rubbing its opposite upper arm, a gesture often associated with feeling cold. This represents the motion for one arm.

cue: Fan face with one hand (Hot)
description: The robot arm moves to the side of its face, then performs a rapid back-and-forth fanning motion to simulate feeling hot.

cue: Open mouth wide and cover it (Sleepy / Yawn)
description: The robot arm moves its gripper towards its mouth region as if to cover an open mouth, then holds it there to convey a sleepy or yawning gesture.

cue: Rub one eye (Tired)
description: The robot brings its hand up to one of its 'eyes' (simulated facial region) and performs a gentle, repetitive rubbing motion, conveying tiredness.

cue: Bow deeply while hands at sides (Apology)
description: The robot transitions from an upright stance to a deep bow, lowering its body and extending slightly forward, holding the final bowed posture as if in apology or deep respect.

cue: Raise both hands and flex index and middle fingers twice (Air quotes)
description: The robot raises its arm to a 'quoting' position at chest height with the gripper opening horizontal, then quickly flexes its 'fingers' (simulated by wrist rotation) twice.

cue: Tap temple with index finger (Think / Smart)
description: The robot raises its arm to its right temple, holding the position briefly, then performs several quick, light taps with the gripper (simulating an index finger) to convey 'thinking' or 'smart'.

cue: Rotate index finger near temple (Crazy)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head, positions the gripper near the temple, and then traces small circles to signal 'crazy' or 'thinking too hard'.

cue: Slide index finger across lips like zipping (Secret / Won’t tell)
description: The robot's arm starts from a neutral position, raises the gripper (simulating an index finger) to the lips, and then performs a quick horizontal sliding motion across them to signify secrecy.

cue: Cross arms over chest (Defensive)
description: The robot arm sweeps laterally across its chest, holding the final position to signal a defensive or closed posture.

cue: Place both hands on hips (Confidence / Annoyed)
description: The robot moves its arm from a relaxed, lowered position to place the gripper on its hip, adopting a posture often associated with confidence or annoyance. The gripper is held vertically.

cue: Lean forward slightly with palms open (Interest)
description: The robot transitions from a neutral stance to a posture of interest, extending its arm slightly forward and lowering it, with the gripper rotated to present an open, receptive 'palm'.

cue: Step back slightly with both palms raised outward (Shock / Surprise)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm to chest level and retracts it slightly, with the gripper opening (representing palms) facing forward, holding this posture to convey shock or surprise.

cue: Cover mouth with palm (Gasp / Oops)
description: The robot quickly brings its hand to cover its mouth, palm inward, as if surprised or indicating a mistake, then holds the position briefly.

cue: Press palms together and bow slightly (Thank you / Respect)
description: The robot raises its arm to bring its gripper (representing palms) together in a vertical orientation near its upper chest, then performs a subtle downward movement to signify a respectful bow.

cue: Raise one hand as if holding an invisible glass (Cheers)
description: The robot raises its arm, bending the elbow and orienting the gripper as if holding an invisible glass, then holds it aloft for a toast.

cue: Raise one palm upward as if inviting a high five (Asking for high five)
description: The robot arm extends forward and slightly upward, rotating its wrist to present an open palm, inviting a high five.

cue: Swing one raised palm downward as if high-fiving air (Imitating high five)
description: The robot arm lifts to a high-five ready position with its palm open, then executes a swift, strong downward swing, mimicking the action of an enthusiastic high five.

cue: Extend one fist forward (Asking for fist bump)
description: The robot extends its arm forward from a neutral position, presenting a closed gripper (fist) as an invitation for a fist bump, then holds the position.

cue: Tap one fist lightly against your other palm (Imitating fist bump)
description: The robot brings its gripper to a neutral, slightly lowered position, then performs a series of quick, small downward taps, mimicking a fist bumping or tapping on an open palm.

cue: Pat your own back (Encouragement)
description: The robot arm moves over its shoulder to its upper back, then performs a series of gentle tapping motions as if patting itself on the back for encouragement.

cue: Draw a circle in the air with index finger (Repeat / Around)
description: The robot extends its arm forward and slightly up, then uses wrist articulation to draw two continuous circles in the air, mimicking a 'repeat' or 'around' gesture.

cue: Slice flat hand horizontally across throat (Cut / Stop it)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its throat, with the gripper flat and horizontal, then performs a sharp, swift slicing motion across the throat area to signify 'cut' or 'stop it'.

cue: Swipe back of fingers outward from under chin (Dismissive / Whatever)
description: The robot arm quickly positions the back of its hand under its chin, with fingers pointing towards its body, then performs a swift, dismissive outward sweep of the hand and forearm.

cue: Drum fingers on table or in air (Waiting / Bored)
description: The robot lowers its hand to a drumming position and then quickly and repeatedly taps its gripper (fingers) downwards, mimicking drumming fingers, often signifying impatience or boredom.

cue: Turn palm upward and curl fingers inward (Give me)
description: The robot extends its arm forward, rotates its wrist to present its palm upward, then repeatedly curls its fingers inward (simulated by rapid wrist pitch) as if beckoning or asking for something.

cue: Extend open palm upward steadily (Offering)
description: The robot's arm begins in a relaxed, lowered position, then smoothly lifts and extends forward, opening its gripper to present an open palm facing upwards, holding the gesture as if offering an item.

cue: Raise both hands beside head (I give up / Surrender)
description: The robot's arm smoothly raises to a high position beside its head with the gripper open, mimicking a 'surrender' or 'I give up' gesture, then holds the expressive pose.

cue: Cover both ears (Too loud / Don’t want to hear)
description: The robot quickly raises its right arm, bringing its gripper to the side of its head near the right ear, and holds it there briefly as if blocking out sound. This gesture implies 'too loud' or 'don't want to hear'. Note: Due to single-arm control in this environment, this configuration simulates covering one ear.

cue: Open both arms wide outward (Welcome)
description: The robot's arm (or arms, assuming mirroring) starts in a slightly forward, lowered position, then sweeps outward, upward, and slightly forward to signify an open and welcoming gesture, holding the pose.

cue: Stretch both arms upward (Relief / Stretch)
description: The robot extends its arm high above its head, stretching outward with an open gripper to convey relief or a physical stretch. This simulates a single arm performing the action of stretching both arms.

cue: Bring one hand to forehead in salute position (Salute)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral, lowered position to rapidly bring the gripper to its right temple, holding the hand in a salute posture for a brief duration.

cue: Place one hand above eyebrows as visor and look far (Searching distance)
description: The robot raises its arm and positions the gripper above its 'eyebrows' like a visor, holding the pose to mimic searching into the distance.
